notes: The after run contains all 78 cases. Only the two fatal-with-waiting cases retain pre-fix outcomes.
The before fixture includes the earlier request-validation changes; its worker uses the prior stream-count gate.
Both fixtures use Debug builds with pinned OpenSSL 3.5.8 and nghttp2 1.70.0.
Raw diagnostics are summarized as event counts and warning/error excerpts; reference timestamps and peer ports are omitted.
Inputs over 256 bytes retain their length, SHA-256 and first 64 bytes; reconstruct them with the named runner case.
Flow probes generate their input adaptively. The over-advertised-max case sends one byte above each peer frame limit (default 16384).
terminal null means no closure observed within the probe budget, not permanent retention.
Every implementation remained running and served a complete 200 response on a fresh connection after every case.
